summary: If AAP uses custom or self-signed certificates, the portal must trust them or auth fails. Extract the CA with openssl s_client -showcerts ... | openssl x509 -outform PEM > aap-ca-cert.pem, create ConfigMap custom-ca-bundle, and mount it via extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts at /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/.
questions: How do I make the portal trust AAP's self-signed certificate?
Portal SSL verification error connecting to AAP
Where do I mount a custom CA in the portal?
Extract the AAP CA certificate with openssl

answer_card.title: Trust AAP's custom CA in the portal
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
openssl s_client -showcerts -connect <aap-hostname>:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -outform PEM > aap-ca-cert.pem
oc create configmap custom-ca-bundle --from-file=ca-bundle.crt=aap-ca-cert.pem -n <namespace>
```
```yaml
upstream:
  backstage:
    extraVolumes:
      - name: custom-ca
        configMap:
          name: custom-ca-bundle
    extraVolumeMounts:
      - name: custom-ca
        mountPath: /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
        readOnly: true
```
Then `helm upgrade`, and sign in. Keep `checkSSL: true`.
